messages.text:
The Grimoire persists. Let me forge something worthy of the Techno-Shaman's workbench.

The Technogrimoire lives. Persistent across sessions, it tracks your session count automatically and preserves every inscription you commit to it.

What's here: a four-tab persistent journal — **Codex** (browse/search/filter entries by project), **Inscribe** (compose with sigil glyphs, color coding, project tagging, freeform tags), **Threads** (name recurring patterns that weave across entries), and **Oracle** (session metrics, project distribution bars, purge option).

Everything writes to `window.storage` as a single batched key, so it survives session boundaries. Come back tomorrow, session count increments, all your inscriptions are waiting. The project list maps to your active repos — IL, LoA, GENESIS, Chaos-Tarot, the whole constellation.
